tagline: Leading California's clean energy transition with reliable electricity infrastructure.
hero_kpi_rationale: Adjusted net income (core earnings) is the primary financial performance indicator used by management to assess the company's operational health, particularly relevant in a regulated industry subject to extraordinary events.

kpis.name: Adjusted net income
kpis.explanation: The company's net income after excluding extraordinary or non-recurring items.
kpis.description: Adjusted net income (core earnings) increased by $620 million, primarily driven by higher earnings at SCE, partially offset by increased losses at the parent company.
kpis.signal: Significant growth in adjusted net income, reflecting improved operational performance.

kpis.name: Net income
kpis.explanation: The company's total profit after all expenses and taxes.
kpis.description: Net income increased significantly by $3,175 million, primarily due to the resolution of the TKM and Woolsey settlement agreements, enabling cost recovery and reduction of extraordinary charges.
kpis.signal: Strong increase in net income, largely influenced by dispute resolutions and cost recoveries.

kpis.name: Non-recurring items
kpis.explanation: Extraordinary costs and revenues not considered representative of ongoing earnings.
kpis.description: Non-recurring items increased by $2,555 million, reflecting charges related to the 2017/2018 wildfire settlements and other events, partially offset by recoveries.
kpis.signal: Significant increase in non-recurring items, primarily due to wildfire settlements.

kpis.name: Electricity demand growth
kpis.explanation: Multiplicative factor of projected electricity consumption growth.
kpis.description: Electricity demand is expected to nearly double (2.0x multiplier) between 2025 and 2045, driven by transportation electrification, new housing construction, and rising commercial and industrial consumption.
kpis.signal: Strong anticipated growth in electricity demand, driven by electrification and consumption trends.

kpis.name: Wildfire mitigation expenses
kpis.explanation: Costs incurred to reduce the risk and impact of wildfires.
kpis.description: Wildfire mitigation expenses of $50 million were incurred in 2025, including shareholder-funded expenditures.
kpis.signal: Ongoing investment in wildfire prevention, reflecting climate-related risks.

kpis.name: Total Revenue
kpis.description: Total revenue extracted from SEC EDGAR companyfacts XBRL for the last eight reported fiscal years (10-K).
kpis.signal: Revenue of $19.317 billion in the latest fiscal year (FY2025).

kpis.name: Net Income
kpis.description: Net income extracted from SEC EDGAR companyfacts XBRL for the last eight reported fiscal years (10-K).
kpis.signal: Net income of $4.459 billion in the latest fiscal year (FY2025).

kpis.name: Operating Income
kpis.description: Operating income extracted from SEC EDGAR companyfacts XBRL for the last eight reported fiscal years (10-K).
kpis.signal: Operating income of $7.093 billion in the latest fiscal year (FY2025).

kpis.name: Dividend per share
kpis.description: Annual dividend per share paid, aggregated from yfinance.dividends over the last seven fiscal years reported by the company.
kpis.signal: Dividend per share of $1.756 in the latest year.

kpis.name: Capital returned (dividends)
kpis.description: Capital returned to shareholders via annual dividends, extracted from yfinance.cashflow over the last four reported fiscal years.
kpis.signal: Capital returned to shareholders via dividends of $1.378 billion in the latest year.

kpis.name: Payout Ratio
kpis.description: Payout ratio = Dividends paid / Net income, calculated over the last four fiscal years from yfinance.cashflow and yfinance.income_stmt.
kpis.signal: Portion of net income distributed as dividends: 29.3% in the latest year.

kpis.name: TKM Settlement Agreement recovery
kpis.explanation: Amount recovered following the TKM settlement agreement, reflecting resolution of past disputes.
kpis.description: Cost recoveries of $1,341 million were recorded following CPUC approval of the TKM settlement agreement in January 2025, positively impacting financial results.
kpis.signal: Resolution of a major dispute and recovery of associated costs.

kpis.name: Woolsey Settlement Agreement recovery
kpis.explanation: Amount recovered following the Woolsey settlement agreement, related to dispute resolution.
kpis.description: Cost recoveries of $1,603 million were recorded following CPUC approval of the Woolsey settlement agreement in December 2025, contributing to the increase in net income.
kpis.signal: Positive impact of another major settlement agreement on company finances.

kpis.name: Wildfire Fund expense amortization
kpis.explanation: Amortization of SCE's contributions to the wildfire mitigation fund.
kpis.description: Amortization charges of $144 million related to SCE's contributions to the wildfire fund were recorded in 2025, representing an ongoing cost associated with risk management.
kpis.signal: Recurring cost related to climate risk management and funding policy.

risks.title: Catastrophic liability related to California wildfires
risks.score_rationale: Risk listed first in forward-looking statements and discussed in a dedicated section 'Southern California Wildfires'; extreme language ('catastrophic', 'significant exposure'); upward trend with the January 2025 Eaton Fire adding to 2017-2018 events; represents the financially heaviest risk category for SCE.

risks.title: Risk of non-recovery of costs through tariffs from CPUC
risks.score_rationale: Cited as the first operational risk in forward-looking statements; strong conditional language ('timely or at all'); stable trend but worsened by the scale of wildfire mitigation investments excluded from the rate base (AB 1054: $1.6 billion, SB 254: $2.9 billion); central regulatory category for a regulated utility.

risks.title: Competition from Community Choice Aggregators (CCAs) and customer attrition
risks.score_rationale: Mentioned in the 'Competitive and Market Risks' section and in forward-looking statements; moderate language ('possible customer bypass or departure'); stable but structurally increasing trend with the proliferation of CCAs in California; impact on cost allocation to remaining customers.

risks.title: Cybersecurity of electric grid control systems
risks.score_rationale: Subject of a dedicated section 'Cybersecurity and Physical Security Risks' in Item 1A and a separate Item 1C; explicit language on critical grid control systems and customer/employee data; upward trend in the utility sector; systemic risk in case of compromise.

risks.title: Operational risks related to construction and maintenance of electrical infrastructure
risks.score_rationale: Explicitly listed in forward-looking statements with detailed sub-risks (worker safety, equipment failure, spare parts availability); precise and comprehensive language; stable trend; central category for a utility managing 50,000 square miles of grid.

risks.title: San Onofre decommissioning: cost overruns and residual nuclear risks
risks.score_rationale: Dedicated section in Item 1A with detailed list of specific sub-risks (irradiated fuel storage, public opposition, contractual disputes); SCE holds 78.21% of San Onofre; stable trend but multi-decade process; costs subject to triennial CPUC review (NDCTP).

risks.title: Regulatory risk related to wildfire safety certification (OEIS)
risks.score_rationale: Specifically mentioned in forward-looking statements as a condition for accessing the Wildfire Fund; new risk introduced by AB 1054; conditional language ('ability to obtain'); emerging/upward trend with SB 254 strengthening requirements; direct consequences on SCE's financial protection.

risks.title: Rate affordability and impact on approval of strategic investments
risks.score_rationale: Explicitly identified in forward-looking statements as a barrier to executing the electrification strategy; direct language on affordability's impact on regulatory approvals and demand growth; upward trend with inflation, tariffs, and rising interest rates; cross-cutting risk affecting the investment plan.

ai_positioning.summary: The company EIX does not mention artificial intelligence, machine learning, or related technologies in its 10-K report.
